content.comment_body: Hello, my [product_name] is connected to my modem and I can access it remotely from any PC, but accessing it from a mobile phone or tablet is not possible. Can you help me? Thank you.
Please use English. English is the preferred language on this forum. Could you clarify your situation? Are you referring to a home network connection or accessing it via the internet?

Hello [user_name], please use English. If you are referring to the older modem feature in [product_name] software, how do you plan to use it on your mobile device? This option is meant for direct [product_name] connection only. Accessing through a browser to the web server is only available over IP, not via the modem feature. Best regards, [user_name] (translated using Google)

analysis.insight_summary: The user can remotely access their [product_name] module from a PC, but access from mobile devices or tablets isn't working. Replies clarify that the method used does not support mobile browsers, since web server access is only supported via IP and not through the older modem function in [product_name] software. This highlights a limitation in multi-platform remote access.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy and consistent remote access to their [product_name] from both PCs and mobile devices.
